text: 欧元区主权债的风险溢价周四大幅上升，表明市场对法国财政和政治局势的担忧正开始外溢至其他市场。意大利与德国2年期国债收益率利差周四几乎翻倍至55个基点，收盘口径下为2020年以来最大单日涨幅。法国债券风险指标再度创下新高，投资者正为明年政治动荡及该国公共财政持续恶化提前布局。10年期法国/德国国债收益率利差收扩14个基点，报141个基点。
text_en: Risk premiums on euro-area sovereign debt rose sharply on Thursday, indicating that market concerns about France's fiscal and political situation are beginning to spill over into other markets. The yield spread between Italian and German 2-year government bonds nearly doubled on Thursday to 55 basis points, the largest one-day increase since 2020 on a closing basis. French bond risk indicators hit new highs again, as investors positioned early for political turmoil next year and continued deterioration in the country's public finances. The 10-year French/German government bond yield spread widened by 14 basis points to 141 basis points.
